crossRefs.note: it is a chronic leprosy in the skin of his body, and the priest shall pronounce him unclean. He shall not isolate him…

translations.web: it is a chronic leprosy in the skin of his body, and the priest shall pronounce him unclean. He shall not isolate him, for he is already unclean.
translations.bsb: it is a chronic skin disease and the priest must pronounce him unclean. He need not isolate him, for he is unclean.
translations.kjv: It is an old leprosy in the skin of his flesh, and the priest shall pronounce him unclean, and shall not shut him up: for he is unclean.
translations.asv: it is an old leprosy in the skin of his flesh, and the priest shall pronounce him unclean: he shall not shut him up, for he is unclean.
